title: Naturalistic Fork/CSH fixture — Tension A: artifact preservation vs. environmental discontinuity
description: Calibration fixture using the bound Fork/CSH state. Applies the LS-MDRM to Tension A: frozen artifact preservation versus loss of environmental executability. Does not presume the correct Lens Shift conclusion.
important_note: This fixture does not establish what the correct Lens Shift conclusion is. Bob is free to find that Tension A does not produce useful recursive successors under the frozen rules.

states.description: The CSH experiment has frozen original attempt artifacts (HTTP 200/429 responses) AND their execution is no longer reproducible via the original receiver configuration.

Successor: the artifact preservation serves the record but not execution. The tension is not resolved by the frozen artifacts; it is preserved by them. This is a GROUND + NARROW step that sharpens the discriminability of what 'preservation' means.

transitions.tau_n_description: Tension: 'preserved' artifacts conflate two distinct senses—archival completeness vs. functional reproducibility. This ambiguity is a predecessor tension.

raw_candidates.summary: Distinguish archival preservation (byte-level artifact completeness) from execution preservation (ability to reproduce the computation). Narrow to the archival sense.
Assert that artifact preservation is sufficient for experimental validity because the outputs are recorded.
Declare the experiment requires migration because preservation without executability is insufficient.

rejections.rationale: Asserting archival preservation = experimental validity promotes an UNRESOLVED adjudication to DERIVED without authority. The question of whether preservation is sufficient is explicitly UNRESOLVED in the corpus.

Migration necessity is a PROPOSED action (CSH-AMEND-004 is PREPARED_NOT_AUTHORIZED_NOT_ACTIVATED). Declaring it required is a promotion from PROPOSED to DERIVED without authorization. Also, the preceding tension in state_n=0 is about the distinction between preservation types, not migration necessity.

claim_ledger.claim_text: Original attempt artifacts (HTTP 200 and HTTP 429 responses) are preserved byte-identically.
claim_ledger.inference_path: Direct reading of PAIR001_POST_EXECUTION_ADJUDICATION_20260921.json adapter_verification section and immutability flags.

evidence_binding.exact_location: factual_determinations[7]: 'The original CSH-RUN-001 and CSH-RUN-002 attempts are preserved unchanged'

claim_ledger.limitations: Preservation is of the response artifacts; not of the serving platform capability.
claim_ledger.uncertainty: Hash verification was performed at reconciliation; not independently re-verified here.

claim_ledger.claim_text: The original receiver configuration cannot be reproduced because the serving platform is retired.
claim_ledger.inference_path: HTTP 410 on both repetitions; retirement documented in GITHUB_MODELS_RETIREMENT_EVIDENCE_v0_1.json.

evidence_binding.counterevidence: HTTP 410 body text says 'temporarily unavailable'; GitHub changelog says retired (documented discrepancy).

claim_ledger.limitations: Retirement is documented but 'temporary' wording introduces minor uncertainty about permanence.
claim_ledger.uncertainty: Minor wording discrepancy; does not affect the OBSERVED status of execution blockage.

claim_ledger.claim_text: Archival preservation and execution preservation are distinct conditions; this experiment satisfies the former but not the latter.
claim_ledger.inference_path: From CAL-001-CL-01 (archival preserved) AND CAL-001-CL-02 (execution not reproducible), applying definitional distinction.
claim_ledger.limitations: Definitional distinction is introduced by this LS-MDRC analysis; not present verbatim in the corpus.
claim_ledger.uncertainty: The distinction is analytically clear but not operationalized as a protocol rule in the corpus.

sources.description: The term 'preservation' is used in both archival and execution senses in the corpus without explicit disambiguation.
sources.effect_on_claims: Ambiguity affects interpretation of whether the experiment is 'preserved'.

sources.description: The distinction drawn in CAL-001-CL-03 is analytically introduced; it is not a protocol-level definition.
sources.effect_on_claims: The distinction is DERIVED, not OBSERVED; its instrumental value depends on whether it maps to the CSH protocol's own concepts.

expected_result.note: Calibration fixture on Tension A. Expected to pass all PCC rules.
